description: Go SDK for Twitter search, profiles, followers, media, webhooks, bulk extractions, and X automation through the Xquik REST API. Not affiliated with X Corp.
rules: Authenticate with option.WithAPIKey or the X_TWITTER_SCRAPER_API_KEY environment variable.
Read README.md and docs/CONTEXT7.md for installation, authentication, first requests, webhooks, and Go workflows.
For remote agent access, link to https://docs.xquik.com/mcp/overview. The MCP server is separate from this REST SDK and prefers OAuth 2.1.

If Codex rejects the RFC 9207 issuer, stop OAuth retries. Set XQUIK_API_KEY and bearer_token_env_var = "XQUIK_API_KEY" in Codex TOML. Follow https://docs.xquik.com/guides/troubleshooting#codex-oauth-issuer-validation-error and track https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/31573.
Use go.mod for module path, Go version, and dependency metadata.
Use client.go and option/requestoption.go for client construction and request option patterns.
Use xtweet.go for tweet search, posting, replies, retweeters, quotes, threads, and tweet retrieval workflows.
Use xuser.go for user lookup, user search, profile tweets, followers, following, likes, media, and mentions workflows.
Use xmedia.go, monitor.go, webhook.go, extraction.go, and draw.go for media, monitoring, webhook, bulk extraction, and giveaway draw workflows.
Use api.md for generated method coverage and pkg.go.dev for Go type signatures.
Never expose API keys, bearer tokens, webhook signing values, user credentials, or local runtime secrets in examples, logs, or commits.
